[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Per-note Ready cap: crowded notes in the CLI, dash, and notes[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every area/project note has a soft cap on its Ready lane [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim](plan.max_ready_per_note, default 5, per-note ready_cap override). [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Crowded notes are named, counted, and easy to act on: in a new `bob[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ready` CLI view, a dash CROWDED chip that opens crowded.md, and a [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]live chip on each note's `## Tasks` heading. All surfaces share one[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]read-time contract, implemented in Rust and in bob-ledger-tools and[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]pinned by shared vectors. The keymap-notice work is fully specified[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]and filed to start after the freshness trial.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF]core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]new decision memory.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#AF87FF]cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]cli: add the read-only top-level `bob ready [NOTE]`: a colored [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]CROWDED/FULL/ROOM bar view, a per-note worklist, schema-1 JSON, --check [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]smoke, and integration tests.[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]inCrowdedNote, groupLabel), built in one memoized O(tasks) pass with [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Vault rollout, docs, and live verification[/bold #D7AFFF]                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]

    [#D7D7AF]ready_cap: off on the three inboxes, add CROWDED to the morning ritual [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]against the plugin, and records verification evidence.[/#D7D7AF]
